outcome: Complications of PH (coagulopathy, febrile illness, urinary tract injury)
cohort: Women who underwent PH at Westmead Hospital, Western Sydney, between 2003 and 2012 (n=56)
finding: Previous cesarean section and placenta praevia were found to be associated with abnormal placentation, the leading indication for PH.
mod_finding: This study on peripartum hysterectomy noted an association between previous cesarean section and the development of placenta previa, a leading indication for peripartum hysterectomy.
